name: physics-assumption-check
description: 先读题图与连接关系，再列方程、核对单位和极限情况，并按风险汇总假设；提供本地题图裁剪放大工具。
scope: Physics exercise interpretation and model-guided solution review. Local PNG/JPEG helper requires Python >=3.10 and Pillow 12.2.0; no network or model call inside the helper. Actual solution quality depends on the host model and legible input.
